tools.name: find_rooms
tools.description: Which of the twelve New Leaf properties in Twin Falls has a room free tonight or on particular nights. Asks all twelve live at the moment you call it. Give the dates: the published availability feeds carry CAPACITY, not vacancy, and say nothing about which nights are taken. With no dates it answers

tools.name: list_properties
tools.description: All twelve New Leaf properties: name, address, phone, which room types each sells online, its rates and its booking URL. Static facts only — it says nothing about whether a room is free tonight. Use find_rooms for that.

tools.name: get_rates
tools.description: What a room costs across the portfolio, by the night and by the week, and the rules that govern a stay: the minimum stay, how a stay under a week is priced, the 30-day cap, the weekly-only studio rule, the 8% Idaho lodging tax, and why $1,000 is never a monthly rate.

tools.name: quote_stay
tools.description: The total for one stay at one New Leaf property: the nights, the tax and what is paid at the property.
